content.value: A homogeneous 50 kg rigid block is suspended by the three springs whose lower ends were originally at the same level shown in figure below. Each steel spring has 24 turns of 10mm diameter wire on a mean diameter wire on a mean diameter of 100 mm and $\mathsf { G } ^ { \prime } = 8 3 \mathsf { G P a }$ . The bronze spring has 48 turns of 20 mm diameter wire on a mean diameter of 150 mm, and $\mathsf { G } = 4 2 \mathsf { G P a }$ . Compute the maximum shearing stress in each spring. Use Wahl's factor.
